features: Accesstive Free Accessibility Checker helps you identify accessibility issues, understand potential legal risk, and know what to fix first. Start with a free Instant Scan, then choose a Live Audit or Human Expert Audit for deeper evaluation. Measure your website against WCAG 2.2, ADA Title III (US), EAA (EU), and BITV 2.0 (Germany) .
title: Accesstive Free Accessibility Checker
